comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 when some comment is a mainly abstract logical rebuttal of the OP's view and has no named real-world example or analogy. This requires a rebuttal stance and abstract reasoning, and it excludes analogies. Feature 1 is 1 when some comment cites a specific real-world example in support, and it does not require rebuttal. The two are not inverses. A comment can be neither, such as a non-rebuttal or a vague or hypothetical comment. A row can also be 1 on both when different comments qualify. They differ in the comment predicate and in eligibility, so they are not the same row function.
